pages: Mr Hori, a lean man of fifty with greying hair in a charcoal jacket, sits at a lab bench turning one thick almanac to a month of August dates. Middle distance: a desk lamp, a tin of chalk, a wall calendar above. Background: the dome's dark curve, first stars, cold window glass.

Mr Hori, a lean man of fifty with greying hair in a charcoal jacket, holds one open almanac up inside the open dome and points past it at the sky. Middle distance: the shutter rail, a wooden step. Background: the slit of the dome, a young crescent moon and stars.

Mr Hori, a lean man of fifty with greying hair in a charcoal jacket, presses one thumb against a printed list of dates pinned to the lab wall, one date already ticked. Middle distance: a bench with a chalk stub, a stool. Background: a window of dark blue, the dome outside.

Mere, a girl of fourteen with dark hair in a plait, a grey school jersey under a navy coat, holds one chrome stopwatch up and checks its white dial and black second hand. Middle distance: the college clock through a doorway, a coat on a hook. Background: the lab, night outside the glass.

Mere, a girl of fourteen with dark hair in a plait, a grey school jersey under a navy coat, works at a desk with one open almanac, one finger along a printed column of times. Middle distance: one desk lamp, her notebook, a pencil. Background: a shelf of books, a dark window.

Mere, a girl of fourteen with dark hair in a plait, a grey school jersey under a navy coat, copies one line of figures into an open notebook with a ballpoint pen. Middle distance: an index card, the closed almanac. Background: the desk lamp, a window full of stars, and checks it twice.

Mrs Reid, a woman of fifty with short grey hair in a heavy brown coat, stands on the terrace beside one reflector telescope, one hand flat on its tripod leg. Middle distance: a folding stool, a thermos. Background: the school field, a low ridge, stars, chalk in her coat pocket.

Mere, a girl of fourteen with dark hair in a plait, a grey school jersey under a navy coat, holds one black card up to the front of the telescope, a coin-sized hole punched in the middle. Middle distance: the tube, a lens cap. Background: the school field, stars, a thin crescent.

Mere, a girl of fourteen with dark hair in a plait, a grey school jersey under a navy coat, stands at the telescope as the young moon climbs above a dark ridge, brown light still in the west. Middle distance: one red lamp, her open notebook. Background: the north range, first stars.

Mere, a girl of fourteen with dark hair in a plait, a grey school jersey under a navy coat, presses the stopwatch and stops it with one thumb, eyes on the crescent. Middle distance: the telescope, her notebook. Background: a faint star beside a young moon, dark sky, her breath showing white.

Mere, a girl of fourteen with dark hair in a plait, a grey school jersey under a navy coat, writes two timings on one index card beside a printed prediction. Middle distance: the stopwatch, a pencil. Background: the telescope, the lit doorway of the lab, her head bent close to the card.

Mere, a girl of fourteen with dark hair in a plait, a grey school jersey under a navy coat, stands in the field with one stub of chalk in her fingers, looking up at a wide crescent Moon with a torn, ragged edge. Middle distance: the reflector telescope, a folding stool. Background: the dark ridge, a field of stars.

Mere, a girl of fourteen with dark hair in a plait, a grey school jersey under a navy coat, runs one finger along the chalk marks down the side of the telescope tube. Middle distance: the star atlas, the stopwatch. Background: the crescent Moon above the ridge, stars, a low stone wall.

Mere, a girl of fourteen with dark hair in a plait, a grey school jersey under a navy coat, sets one wristwatch flat on the table beside an open star atlas. Middle distance: the chrome stopwatch, a pencil. Background: the warm room, frost on the window, a lamp with a low shade.

Mere, a girl of fourteen with dark hair in a plait, a grey school jersey under a navy coat, draws one chalk mark on the side of the telescope and checks the stopwatch. Middle distance: the atlas, a stool. Background: the crescent Moon among stars, the dark ridge, her breath fogging.

Mere, a girl of fourteen with dark hair in a plait, a grey school jersey under a navy coat, sits in the front seat of a parked car and holds one index card up to the mirror. Middle distance: the steering wheel, a frosted screen. Background: the car park lamps, the school gate.

Mere, a girl of fourteen with dark hair in a plait, a grey school jersey under a navy coat, stands at the school gate holding one index card out in the cold. Middle distance: the low stone wall, a frost-white gate post. Background: the car park, the milky way and a young moon.

Mr Hori, a lean man of fifty with greying hair in a charcoal jacket, pulls one car door shut and gets in behind the wheel. Middle distance: the index card on the seat, a torch on the dash. Background: the school gate, frost, the milky way, the cold on his hands.

Mere, a girl of fourteen with dark hair in a plait, a grey school jersey under a navy coat, rests one hand on a concrete fence post and does the sum on the back of it. Middle distance: posts running on into the dark, a gate. Background: the sky pouring over the posts, a young crescent moon.

Mere, a girl of fourteen with dark hair in a plait, a grey school jersey under a navy coat, writes three figures in one open notebook at a bedroom desk with a ballpoint pen. Middle distance: the chrome stopwatch, a mug. Background: a window full of stars, frost on the glass.
